title: Run for the Corner
setup: White's king has just stepped up to b6 to walk the a-pawn home, and Black has three squares.
hint: A rook's pawn has only one file of its own; ask which corner the defending king has to be holding.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Kb8}} is the only move. A rook's pawn cannot be escorted past a king that holds a8 and b8: {{a6}} {{Ka8}}, and after a7 Black has no legal move at all, which is stalemate. Step away to d7 or d8 instead and the white king simply walks around and queens.
